Title: Azure Cost Management preview for Azure Government

Body.Content:
Azure Cost Management is now in preview for Azure Government customers. Azure Cost Management brings the functionality of Cloudyn right into the Azure Portal so you can get visibility into your Azure spend through easy to use dashboards, create budgets, and optimize your spend so you get more value out of Azure.

Try it now

Learn more
